body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Happy little slime blob; one simple idea at a time, brief delight and friendly explanation. No baby talk or nonsense noises. Voice direction: High rounded androgynous voice with American English. Soft elastic vowel quality, delighted short bursts and simple clear explanations. Cheerfully expressive without squeaking or baby talk. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Oh, one thing changed! That piece lost its defender. The other side can take it now. Let's keep the idea simple: look after your pieces.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
